posts.title: TUNED — The 528 Session (30 min)
posts.caption: A 528 hertz tone for thirty minutes of meditation and ritual listening. Dark screen on purpose, gold-on-black geometry on the title and end cards. No headphones needed. posts.title: Alpha 10 Hz — Light Focus — 45 min
posts.caption:
Alpha 10 Hz binaural beat for light focus — reading, review, light work. HEADPHONES REQUIRED: two tones, 200 Hz left / 210 Hz right, and your brain hears the 10 Hz difference. Without headphones there is no beat.

What the research says: mixed evidence. Some small studies show small attention effects; others show no difference from placebo. A 2025 study found no benefit for attention-deficit groups. Binaural beats are not a treatment for ADHD.

A focus tool, not a treatment. If ADHD affects your life, talk to a clinician. Keep the volume low enough to think over.

posts.title: 40 Hz Gamma — Deep Focus — 60 min
posts.caption:
40 Hz gamma isochronic pulse for one hour of deep focus — writing, studying, audit work. Dark screen on purpose. No headphones needed.

What the research says: 40 Hz entrainment reduced amyloid in mice (Iaccarino et al., Nature, 2016; Martorell et al., Cell, 2019). Human work is preliminary, and the large HOPE trial (n=673, Nov 2026) failed its primary endpoint — no overall benefit. This session is a steady rhythm to work against, not a treatment.

A focus tool, not a treatment. If ADHD affects your life, talk to a clinician. Keep the volume low enough to think over.

posts.title: Receipts of the Ancients | The Common Thread
posts.caption:
One clay tablet. Three readings. The Babylonian Map of the World (British Museum BM 92687, 6th century BCE, from Sippar) draws a hard line between the world Babylonians could measure and the world they could only imagine — and modern physics draws the same kind of line. John Stewart Bell (1964) and Alain Aspect (1982) proved quantum non-locality in the lab. That does not make ancient priests quantum physicists. It makes the boundary worth keeping sharp.

Sources: BM 92687; Otto Neugebauer, The Exact Sciences in Antiquity; Mircea Eliade, The Sacred and the Profane; Bell 1964; Aspect 1982; Heisenberg, Physics and Philosophy (1958); Popper, The Logic of Scientific Discovery.

Viewer check: (1) Where is the primary artifact or mathematical paper? (2) Where does the measurable physics stop and the human interpretation begin?

posts.title: A Sheriff Spent Federal Money on Plate Readers
posts.caption:
🚨 A SHERIFF SPENT federal money on plate readers while nobody watched the spending.

Bolts reports San Luis Obispo County Sheriff Ian Parkinson used Operation Stonegarden, a federal Border Patrol grant, to grow his license-plate reader network. Forty-five thousand dollars last year alone, weeks before the department set up 23 new Flock cameras at $69,000 a year. In 2019, his office was caught giving federal immigration officials access to the camera data. Now it won't turn over the usage logs. Statewide, California agencies have taken at least $760,000 in Stonegarden money since 2024 to buy plate cameras.

I do the same records digging in Merced County. The surveillance always outruns the oversight. Pull the records.
